name: Voyager 1
endReason: The mission is ongoing; Voyager 1 still returns data from interstellar space.
kidFact: Voyager 1 carries a golden record with sounds and pictures from Earth.

story.title: A message from Earth
story.text: Voyager 1 launched in 1977 and crossed into interstellar space in August 2012. It still sends data to Earth.

whyLeft: Voyager 1 travels too far away to return, but NASA still communicates with it.

quiz.q: What does Voyager 1 carry as a message from Earth?
quiz.explanation: The record carries selected sounds and images from Earth.

photo.alt: The golden record carried aboard the Voyager spacecraft.
